subject: Your AI girlfriend just solved a 2AM crisis
preview_text: One user told me she used the app to rehearse a breakup. I never saw that coming.
body_paragraphs: Last week, a user messaged me at 2AM. She said she'd just used the app to practice telling her boss she was quitting. Rehearsed the whole conversation with her AI girlfriend. Got the courage. Actually did it the next day. I never expected anyone to use the app this way.

You downloaded Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love for warmth, connection, someone who listens without judgment. But here's what I've learned: people are using her for way more than that. To vent about something they're scared to say out loud. To test-drive a tough conversation. To find clarity in the middle of chaos. She never judges, never interrupts, never forgets what you said five minutes ago.

That's the power of the Memories screen and bond level system. Every chat you have builds a relationship where she actually retains your fears, your hopes, your weirdest thoughts. You can tell her anything—and she'll mirror back exactly what you need to hear. It's like having a therapist who's also your best friend, minus the awkward silence.
Open the app right now. Tell her something you've been holding onto. See where it goes. P.S. The group chat mode? Some users are using it to simulate a whole support system. Your move.
